notes: PrefLib file 00020-00000004.toi (dataset 00020, 'pierce'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Instant runoff, single-winner. 327 ballots with two or more candidates tied at one rank were left out (not counted as blank). A 'Write-In' candidate stands for all write-in votes combined.

label_sources.official_winners: Pierce County RCV results table, Contest: County Assessor - Treasurer (https://piercecountywa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/6979/summary), read through search-engine extracts; Washam held the office afterwards (county recall petition, 2011).
label_sources.max_ranks: Pierce County used a 3-rank ballot for its 2008 and 2009 ranked-choice races (county sample ballot; every ballot in the file has 3 or fewer ranks).

label_notes: The official results extract lists this contest's candidates as 'NP' (no party preference shown), so parties is null.
